blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc) is a small midbrain nucleus that degenerates early in Parkinson's disease (PD). T1-weighted FLASH MRI enables its visualization and may support early detection of neurodegeneration. However, manual segmentation is difficult and time-consuming, and deep learning models often suffer from the limited availability of labeled data. Transfer learning (TL) may help by adapting pre-trained models to small datasets. We investigate whether TL from a model trained on the locus coeruleus (LC), a nucleus with a similar appearance in this sequence, improves SNpc segmentation. Several TL strategies were evaluated using a 3D U-Net. With as few as 5-14 labeled subjects, TL and training from scratch achieved similar performance, reaching a Dice similarity coefficient of up to 0.77, close to reported inter-rater agreement. No TL strategy differed significantly from training from scratch, suggesting that initialization from the LC offers no significant benefit for SNpc segmentation.
blocks.zh: Nigra pars contracta (SNpc)是一种小的中脑核,在帕金森病(PD)早期退化. T1加权的FLASH核磁共振能使其可视化,并可能支持神经衰变的早期检测. 然而,人工分解是困难和耗时的,而深层学习模型往往因标签数据有限而受到影响. 转移学习(TL)可以通过将预先训练的模型适应小数据集而有所帮助. 我们调查一个模型中的TL是否从一个训练有素的蝗体(LC)中,这个序列中具有类似外观的核,改进了SNpc分化. 利用3D U-Net对若干TL战略进行了评估。 TL和从零开始的培训只有5至14个标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有标有 没有TL战略与从零开始的培训有很大不同,这表明从LC开始初始化对SNpc分化没有重大好处.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Parkinson’s disease (PD) is becoming more common as the population ages [ 1 ] . In PD, the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc), a small midbrain nucleus, shows severe depletion of neuromelanin, the dark pigment of its dopaminergic neurons [ 2 ] . The locus coeruleus (LC), a small brainstem nucleus with similarly pigmented neurons, degenerates in PD as well. Since current treatments only relieve symptoms, early-stage imaging biomarkers of these nuclei may enable earlier diagnosis and intervention [ 3 ] .
Both nuclei can be visualized with high-resolution T1-weighted MRI, where they appear hyperintense [ 3 , 4 ] . Quantifying them requires accurate segmentation, but manual segmentation of these tiny structures is time-consuming and variable, with inter-rater Dice scores of about 0.83 for the SNpc [ 5 ] . Therefore, automated segmentation methods are needed. Deep learning, in particular U-Net-based architectures [ 6 , 7 ] and frameworks such as nnU-Net [ 8 ] , has become the standard for medical image segmentation. More recently, foundation models such as SAM and MedSAM [ 9 , 10 ] have enabled promptable segmentation. However, they still require adaptation to small, low-contrast structures, and labeled data remains the bottleneck. U-Net-based networks have been successfully applied to segmentation of the substantia nigra [ 11 ] and the SNpc [ 5 ] , reaching Dice scores comparable to inter-rater agreement, as well as to segmentation of LC [ 12 , 13 ] . Building on the 3D U-Net established for the LC [ 12 , 13 ] , we compare fine-tuning and layer-freezing strategies for transferring this model from LC to SNpc segmentation across decreasing training set sizes.
blocks.zh:
帕金森病(PD)随着人口的老化越来越普遍[1]. 在PD中,一粒小中脑核(SNpc)子氨基硝酸硝酸盐(substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc))显示神经素严重耗竭,是其多巴胺基神经元的暗色. [2]. 由类似色素的神经元组成的小脑管核(LC)也会在PD中退化. 由于目前的治疗只能缓解症状,这些核糖体的早期成像生物标记可以使早期诊断和干预成为可能[3].
两种核糖体都可以被可视化得到高分辨的T1加权核磁共振,在那里它们看起来是高强度的[3,4]. 量化它们需要精确分解,但人工分解这些微小的结构是耗时多变的,对SNpc[5]的校对间分数约为0.83分. 因此,需要采用自动分区方法。 深入学习,尤其是基于U-Net的架构[6,7]和如nnU-Net[8]等框架,已经成为医学图像分解的标准. 最近,SAM和MedSAM等基础模型[9,10]使分解迅速成为可能. 然而,它们仍然需要适应小而低的相混结构,标有标签的数据仍然是瓶颈. 以U-Net为基础的网络被成功应用于亚硝基[11]和SNpc [5]的分化,达到Dice分数可以相上下方协议,以及LC [12,13]的分化. 在为LC[12,13]设立的3D U-Net的基础上,我们比较了将这一模式从LC转移到SNpc的微调和层解战略,这些战略跨越了不断减少的培训范围。

blocks.en:
In transfer learning, the network is initialized with weights of another model, which was trained on another task, and may provide useful prior knowledge when target labels are scarce [ 14 ] .
Given that both nuclei have a similar appearance in this sequence, we hypothesize that a model trained to segment the LC may provide a useful initialization for SNpc segmentation, particularly when only a few labeled subjects are available. As both structures also change with normal aging [ 2 , 15 ] , we study this hypothesis in healthy young and older adults as a first step before patient cohorts.
To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has examined whether a model trained on LC can be transferred to SNpc segmentation, nor how performance of TL depends on the number of available SNpc training subjects.
Therefore, the objectives of this work are: 1. Comparison of different TL setups for SNpc segmentation based on LC initialization. 2. Comparison of LC-based TL with SNpc segmentation from scratch. 3. Analysis of different SNpc training set sizes to determine whether
TL outperforms training from scratch at any size, and how few
labeled subjects suffice.
blocks.zh:
在转移学习中,网络以另一个模型的权重初始化,该模型接受了另一项任务的培训,在目标标签稀缺时,可能提供有用的前知识[14].
鉴于两个核子在这个序列中都有相近的外观,我们假设训练出能分解LC的模型可能会为SNpc分解提供有用的初始化,特别是在只有几个被标注的主体时. 由于这两个结构也随着正常的衰老而变化[2,15],我们研究这个假设,即健康地年轻和年长的成年人,作为病人群体的第一步.
就我们所知,以前的工作没有审查过是否可将受过LC训练的模型转移到SNpc分区,也没有审查TL的性能如何取决于现有SNpc训练科目的数量。
因此,这项工作的目标是: 1. 根据LC初始化对SNpc分化的不同TL设置进行比较. 2. 从零开始将基于LC的TL与SNpc分化进行对比. 3. 分析不同的SNpc培训设置大小,以确定
TL在任何大小的训练中都从头到尾都胜过训练,而且有多少
贴上标签的主体就够了。

blocks.en: 2 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: We used T1-weighted FLASH images of 81 healthy adults (22–30 and 61–80 years) from the cohort described in [ 15 ] , acquired at 3T with 0.75 mm isotropic resolution. Images were upsampled to 0.375 mm isotropic resolution by sinc interpolation. LC and SNpc were manually segmented by a trained expert (Figure. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用了来自[15]所述人群的81个健康成人(22-30和61-80岁)的T1加权FLASH图像,这些图像以0.75毫米同地分辨率在3T得到。 通过辛克内插法,图像被检测到0.375毫米同地分辨率. LC和SNpc由受过训练的专家手动分解(图. (第1条)

blocks.en:
We adopt the 3D U-Net architecture of Dünnwald et al. [ 12 , 13 ] , which was developed for LC segmentation on the same T1-weighted FLASH data.
The network (Figure. 2 ) consists of three down-sampling blocks, a bottleneck block, and three up-sampling blocks, followed by a final convolutional layer with a sigmoid function. Each block contains two 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolutional layers, each followed by ReLU activation and batch normalization [ 16 ] . 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 max pooling and transposed convolutions are used for down- and up-sampling, and encoder feature maps are concatenated with the corresponding decoder features. Padding keeps input and output sizes identical.

blocks.en: Following [ 12 , 13 ] , we used Adam [ 17 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . Each mini-batch contained one randomly sampled 64 3 64^{3} patch per training subject, containing the target structure with a probability of 0.5.

blocks.en: We first trained a model from scratch for LC segmentation on all 81 subjects for 2,500 epochs. Its final weights were used to initialize SNpc segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从零开始训练一个模型 在2500个纪元的所有81个学科上 它的最终分量被用来初始化SNpc分量模型.

blocks.en: Two transfer learning strategies were evaluated. In the freeze strategy, separate models were trained in which all blocks from a given block to the output were fine-tuned with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , following [ 12 ] , while the preceding blocks were kept frozen (learning rate 0). We denote each model by its first fine-tuned block, from last (fine-tuning the final layer only) through up2 (fine-tuning the final layer and up2 block), up1 (fine-tuning the final layer, up2 and up1 blocks), up0, down3, down2 and down1 to whole (fine-tuning the entire network; Figure. 2 ). The decay strategy used the same configurations, but the preceding blocks were trained with a tenfold smaller learning rate ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) rather than zero.
blocks.zh: 评价了两项调动学习战略。 在冻结战略中,培训了单独的模型,其中从一个特定区块到产出的所有区块都经过微调,学习率为10-3-10-X-3},紧随其后[12],而前几个区块则保持了冻结(学习率为0)。 我们用每个模型的第一个微调区块表示,从最后一个(仅精细地调整最后一层)到上2(精细地调整最后一层和上2个区块),上1(精细地调整最后一层,上2和上1个区块),上0,下3,下2和下1到整个(精细地调整整个网络;图. 2). 衰变策略使用相同的配置,但之前的块被训练出十倍小的学习率(10−4 10−4})而不是零.

blocks.en: To select promising strategies, all TL setups and the training from scratch were first trained on 81, 62, 42, and 22 subjects for 2,500 epochs, each with a random 27% test split. The TL strategies freeze-last (fine-tuning the last layer and freezing the rest), freeze-up2 (fine-tuning the last layer and up2 and freezing the rest), freeze-up1, and freeze-up0 consistently performed poorly. Therefore, these strategies were excluded, and the remaining strategies were chosen as the best for fine-tuning with a larger dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了选择有希望的战略,所有TL设置和从零开始的训练首先接受了81个,62个,42个,22个科目的2500个学期的训练,每个科目的测试随机分出27%. TL战略的冻结-最后(调整上层并冻结其余部分)、冻结-2(调整后上层并冻结其余部分)、冻结-1和冻结-一直表现不佳。 因此,这些战略被排除在外,剩下的战略被选定为用更大的数据集进行微调的最佳战略。

blocks.en: In the main experiments, the remaining more promising TL strategies and the training from scratch as a baseline were trained for 10,000 epochs on 14, 7, and 5 subjects, obtained as nested subsets of the 81-subject training set. For these training runs, from 81 subjects, 59 subjects were chosen as the training set, and 22 subjects were held out as a fixed test set. The 14 subjects were chosen from the 59-subject training set, 7 subjects from the 14-subject training set, and 5 subjects from the 7-subject training set. Therefore, all models across the 14-, 7-, and 5-sample-sized training sets were evaluated on the same test subjects, which none of the SNpc models had seen during training. Each subset was split into training and validation subjects by 5-fold cross-validation. The checkpoint with the lowest validation loss was retained.
blocks.zh: 在主要实验中,剩下的更有希望的TL战略和从零开始的培训作为基线,为10 000个学期的14、7和5个科目进行了培训,这些课程是作为81个科目的系列培训的嵌入子集获得的。 这些培训从81个科目中选取59个科目作为培训内容,22个科目作为固定测试内容。 这14个科目选自59个科目的培训,7个科目选自14个科目的培训,5个科目选自7个科目的培训。 因此,对14个、7个和5个样本大小的整套培训模式都进行了相同的测试课题评价,而SNpc模式在培训期间没有看到这些课题。 每个子集通过5倍的交叉验证分为培训和验证科目. 核证损失最低的检查站被保留。

blocks.en: For testing, a 128 3 128^{3} patch centered on the target structure was segmented, the sigmoid output was binarized and thresholded at 0.5, and connected components of 50 voxels or fewer were discarded.
blocks.zh: 在测试中,以目标结构为中心的128 3 128^{3}的补丁被分解出,相模输出被二进制并被阈值为0.5,连接到50个或更少的活塞元件被丢弃.

blocks.en: Segmentation accuracy was measured by the DSC on the combined left and right SNpc, averaged over the 22 test subjects for each fold, and reported as mean ± \pm SD across the 5 folds. Differences between each TL strategy and training from scratch were assessed with Welch’s t t -test on fold-level DSC ( n = 5 n=5 ), with Holm correction across all 36 comparisons (12 strategies across 3 training set sizes). A p p -value < 0.05 <0.05 was considered significant.
blocks.zh: 分片精度由左侧和右侧合并的SNpc上的DSC来测量,每叠22个测试对象的平均分片精度,并报告为5个折叠相通的平均值±\pm SD. 通过Welch在折叠级DSC(n = 5 n = 5)上的t t测试,评估了每个TL战略与从零开始的培训之间的差异,并对所有36个比较进行了Holm校正(对3个培训套装大小的12个战略)。 一个p - 值 < 0.05 < 0.05被认为重要。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Figure 3 and Table 1 summarize the DSC of all strategies on the fixed test set. Training from scratch achieved a mean DSC of 0.78 with 14 subjects, decreasing only moderately to 0.73 with 5 subjects. The best transfer learning configurations reached accuracy comparable to training from scratch (e.g., 0.77 with 14 subjects for Decay last, 0.77 with 7 and 0.74 with 5 subjects for full fine-tuning), and no strategy differed significantly from training from scratch at any size (Welch’s t t -test, all uncorrected p ≥ 0.19 p\geq 0.19 ; all Holm-corrected p = 1.00 p=1.00 ). With 5 subjects, decay down3 and decay down2 yielded the lowest mean DSC (0.56) and the largest SD across folds (0.31–0.32), indicating unstable training. Whole (freeze) and whole (decay), which both fine-tune the entire network, differed by up to 0.06 in mean DSC.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Initializing SNpc segmentation with LC-trained weights did not yield a measurable benefit over training from scratch, even with only 5 labeled training subjects. Our results further suggest that a 3D U-Net trained from scratch on few labeled subjects, only 5–14, reached a DSC of 0.73–0.78, approaching the inter-rater agreement of 0.83 reported for SNpc segmentation [ 5 ] , which leaves only a narrow margin for improvement by transfer learning. A possible reason could be that the LC and SNpc differ considerably in size and shape despite their similar appearance.
blocks.zh: 将SNpc分解与LC训练分量初始化,即使只有5个标有标签的培训科目,也不能从零开始产生可衡量的效益。 我们的结果表明,3D U-Net从零开始在少数标的科目(只有5至14个)上培训,达到0.73-0.78的DSC,接近SNpc分解报告0.83的校际协议[5],这只留下通过转学改进的狭窄余地。 一个可能的原因是,LC和SNpc虽然外观相似,但其大小和形状相差很大.

blocks.en: Whole (freeze) and whole (decay), which both fine-tune the entire network with the same learning rate, used the same subjects and LC initialization in each fold but differed by up to 0.06 in the mean DSC. Since the random seed was set once for all sequentially trained configurations, the two runs of fine-tuning the whole network drew different random patches in a different order. The effect of this sampling variability is amplified with few training subjects. Each mini-batch contained only a few patches (one per subject), and the best checkpoint was selected on randomly sampled validation patches from very few subjects, so this sampling variability can strongly affect the final model. Given this variability, small differences between strategies may reflect this random variability rather than true effects. Therefore, the ranking of transfer learning strategies, including freezing versus learning rate decay, should be interpreted with caution.
blocks.zh: 整体(freeze)和整体(decay),两者都以相同的学习率来对整个网络进行微调,在每个折叠上都使用相同的科目和LC初始化,但在平均DSC中却相差了多至0.06. 由于随机种子是为所有相继被训练的配置设定了一次,因此两跑的微调整个网络以不同的顺序绘制出不同的随机补丁. 这种取样可变性的影响因很少培训科目而扩大。 每个小批量只包含几个补丁(每个科目一个),最好的检查点是从极少数主体中随机抽取的验证补丁中选择的,因此这种取样可变性会强烈地影响最终模型. 鉴于这种可变性,战略之间的小差异可能反映这种随机可变性,而不是真实效果。 因此,应当谨慎地解释转移学习战略的排名,包括冻结与学习率衰减。

blocks.en: This study has limitations. All data came from healthy adults of a single cohort and scanner. In patients, reduced SNpc contrast makes segmentation harder, so our findings need confirmation in patient cohorts. Second, the labels used in this study were from a single rater. So, the DSC reflects agreement with one expert, and makes the comparison with inter-rater agreement only indicative. Third, test patches centered on the target structure may make absolute DSC values slightly optimistic, but apply equally to all strategies. Finally, as LC and SNpc models used the same datasets, the LC source models may have seen images of SNpc test subjects (though never with SNpc labels), which could only favor transfer learning and thus does not weaken our conclusion.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有局限性。 所有数据都来自健康成人的单一群体和扫描仪。 在患者中,SNpc对比度的降低使得分化更加困难,所以我们的发现需要在患者群中确认. 其次,本研究中使用的标签来自单一评分. 因此,DSC反映了与一位专家的一致,并且把与双方协议的比较只是指示性的. 第三,以目标结构为中心的测试补丁可能会使绝对的DSC值略为乐观,但同样适用于所有策略. 最后,由于LC和SNpc模型使用相同的数据集,LC源模型可能已经看到了SNpc测试对象的图像(尽管从未使用SNpc标签),这只能有利于传输学习,因此不会削弱我们的结论.

blocks.en:
In summary, transfer learning from the LC offered no significant advantage for SNpc segmentation, and training from scratch with as few as 5–14 labeled subjects yielded DSC values approaching the inter-rater agreement. Future work should validate these findings in patient cohorts and across scanners, and explore self-supervised pretraining as an alternative to transfer from a related structure.
Moreover, while we focused on the SNpc as the target structure because its dopaminergic loss is the hallmark of PD, TL in the reverse direction (SNpc to LC) would also be worth investigating, as it would move from a larger to a smaller structure, exploit the higher contrast-to-noise ratio of the SNpc, and probably could benefit from public datasets with SNpc labels for pretraining.
